title: Tom Yum
paragraphs: Tom Yum is a hot-and-sour soup famous for its fragrant broth of lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, and chilies. The most iconic versions are Tom Yum Goong (shrimp) and Tom Yum Nam Khon (creamy with evaporated milk).
Its bold flavors come from a balance of spicy, sour, salty, and a hint of sweetness. Fresh herbs are bruised to release aroma, then removed before serving for a clean, lively broth.
